name: Call My Bluff
summary: Teams invent fake definitions for obscure words while opponents try to spot the true definition.
rules_text: Play alternates between two teams of three. A secret obscure word is chosen and revealed only to the bluffing team, who know its true dictionary definition. The three bluffers each invent a definition: one states the true definition, the other two invent plausible bluffs. They present the three definitions in random order to the opposing team. The guessing team confers and chooses which definition they believe is true. If they are correct they score one point, otherwise the bluffing team scores one point. Roles then swap. After a fixed number of words the team with most points wins.
